spec.name: Trend v4
spec.notes: Built for calm markets: the signal works in calm regimes and gives back part of it in stressed ones. Intended to run at reduced size when volatility is high.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.1, annual return 6%, maximum drawdown 21%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy is simple, transparent, and utilizes a standard momentum-based signal. With only two trials conducted, there is no evidence of data mining or overfitting. The performance metrics are modest and realistic for a long-short quantile strategy. As no charges were filed and no damaging exhibits exist to suggest lookahead bias or other methodological flaws, the strategy is approved for deployment at full requested capital.
